after.assessment_guidance: Use the current audiology report to record a documented grade and the lowest affected frequency separately. Table 6 links a grade of at least 2 with hearing loss reaching 2 kHz or lower. This is a combined treatment-action criterion, not a grading scale. Preserve any previous cisplatin discontinuation even if the current assessment improves.
after.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not define its hearing grades or name a grading edition. Do not treat generic CTCAE severity anchors or the 2 kHz boundary as a hearing-grade definition. Audiology must identify the applicable grading system and patient context.

before.label: Grade of previous febrile-neutropenia episode (current or historical as stated; CTCAE grade)
before.assessment_guidance: Grade the named event using its own CTCAE criteria; distinguish current findings from previous episodes.

after.label: Grade documented for the previous febrile-neutropenia episode

options.label: No previous febrile-neutropenia episode
options.description: No previous febrile-neutropenia episode recorded; this is not a severity grade for an active episode.
Previous episode documented as grade 3; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.
Previous episode documented as grade 4; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.

after.assessment_guidance: Review the previous episode record, including contemporaneous neutrophils, temperature, clinical severity and the grading system used. Table 4 distinguishes grade 4 from consideration for grade 3, and later recurrence despite G-CSF. Current febrile neutropenia or suspected sepsis belongs in the separate urgent current-event field; current normal counts do not erase prior history. The source addresses prior grades 3 and 4 only. Leave an unclassified episode unresolved and obtain clinical-record review; do not map unsupported or unknown historical severity to no previous episode.
after.grading_source_label: NCCP 00463 v4 Table 4 prior febrile-neutropenia bands
after.source_grading_note: The NCCP table names grade 3 and grade 4 action bands but does not define their criteria or identify a CTCAE edition. Do not equate the episode grade with an ANC-only neutropenia grade or apply v5/v6 haematology bands automatically. Values 1 and 2 are not defined by this source table. The no-previous-episode choice is an absence value, not a formal NCCP grade 0.
